important_caveat: Anchor battery is a REGRESSION SUITE, not validation (Kwame's binding warning). Passing all active anchors (in this mandate; 2 deferred -- see deferred_cases) means the model didn't break on known cases; it does NOT mean the methodology is correct. External claims must distinguish regression-test results from validation results.

policy_notes: Per Kwame's warning: passing all active anchors does NOT validate the methodology. It is a regression suite that catches obvious failure modes (e.g., a model that ranks Norway as high-coup-risk).

Per Component 6 / DECISION v3: validation script computes pass/fail per case automatically and emits a per-case rank + score. No BH/FDR correction applies to anchor results -- they are regression tests, not hypothesis tests.
Per founder addendum (note 2): Malta-Military-Coup alone is one data point. The 8-case battery formalizes 'multiple test cases that together stress the methodology from different angles'.
Country slugs follow qgi-ml/shared/slug.py convention (lowercase, underscore-delimited; matches qgi-data/events/curated/<slug>.json filenames).

Cases 1 (Malta-military_coup) and 4 (Tunisia-democratic_transition) are DEFERRED in this mandate because their recipes hard-gated under verified-only n_positive. They re-enter when verification rate raises n+v above the gate threshold -- not by re-curation, by re-verification.

schema_notes: expected_rank_band is a percentile interval [low, high] in [0, 1] over the country distribution for the named recipe (lower = lower risk).
expected_rank_volatility_max is the maximum allowed rank-percentile delta across model versions for rank-stability cases.
min_recipes_in_band is required for failed-state cases checking simultaneous high rank across multiple recipes.
year_window restricts the test to specific years for time-windowed true-positive cases.

recipe (singular Layer-3 ID) and recipe_sentinel (cross-recipe sentinel string) are mutually exclusive: a case has exactly one. resolves_to_layer1 + resolution_logic accompany every recipe_sentinel for machine-readable contract.
Validation script should derive n_active_cases / n_deferred_cases from len(active_cases) / len(deferred_cases), not from the informational fields above (which document intent at gen time).
